codeReview.summary: Fix adequately addresses the blocking issues from the prior review. Metric naming bug is fixed - 'tool_calls_total' and 'tool_call_duration_seconds' now correctly use namespace('xiaomaolv') without duplicate 'xiaomaolv_' prefix in the name, producing proper metric names 'xiaomaolv_tool_calls_total' and 'xiaomaolv_tool_call_duration_seconds'. TrajectoryMetrics is properly integrated into MessageService via builder pattern with with_trajectory_metrics(), and record_tool_call() is invoked in all 4 MCP tool execution paths. Non-blocking issues from prior review remain (unused underscore parameters, naming inconsistency across metrics).

issues.description: record_trajectory takes '_tool_calls: usize' parameter that is never used. The parameter is documented but not utilized - just prefixed with underscore.
record_tool_call takes '_ok: bool' parameter that is never used. The parameter is documented but not utilized - just prefixed with underscore.

Inconsistent metric naming: some metrics (trajectories_total, avg_iterations_per_trajectory, trajectory_duration_seconds) use just 'xiaomaolv_' prefix without namespace, while others (tool_calls_total, tool_call_duration_seconds) use both prefix and namespace. This inconsistency makes metrics harder to discover and query in Prometheus. Note: The fix corrected the broken metrics but the remaining inconsistency persists.
